title: Quick Roasted Vietnamese Chicken Jjigae
description: A low-carb-friendly, one-pan roasted chicken dish featuring a crispy exterior and a glassy-jelly interior, inspired by traditional Vietnamese cuisine.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breasts under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oil, fish sauce, garlic, ginger, chili flakes, salt, and pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the chicken breasts.
Place the chicken breasts in the bottom of the ttukbaegi earthenware cook vessel, leaving a small gap between each breast.
Drizzle the remaining mixture from the bowl over the top of the chicken breasts.
Cover the vessel with a bamboo tray to create a makeshift steamer.
Place the vessel in the oven and roast for 15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the vessel from the oven and sprinkle the chopped scallions over the top of the chicken breasts.
Return the vessel to the oven and roast for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the scallions are lightly browned.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let the chicken rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips and serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
